Settlement documentation

Understand the workflow.
Follow the evidence.

A settlement brings the recipient, agreed terms, execution and result into one record. Start with the lifecycle, then review integration and operating controls.

From instruction to final record

  1. Define the recipient and terms

    Identify a verified Indian beneficiary, the required recipient INR amount, payment purpose and funding currency. Link the instruction to a commercial reference.

  2. Check requirements before authorization

    Preflight identifies outstanding requirements. Review the quote, fees and validity, then authorize the agreed settlement under the workspace policy.

  3. Observe execution

    Funding, payout execution and provider observations are tracked against the instruction. Exceptions need an explicit resolution rather than an assumed success.

  4. Reconcile and retain the result

    Match delivery evidence to the expected amount and recipient. A settled outcome is supported by reconciliation and a final receipt.

Five customer-facing states

Ready
The requirements are satisfied; execution has not been authorized.
Settling
The authorized settlement is progressing through execution.
Settled
Delivery and reconciliation support the final result; the receipt is available.
Action required
A stated requirement or exception needs attention.
Cancelled
The settlement did not complete and has a recorded resolution.

The demo illustrates these states. It does not represent a live provider connection or a completed financial transaction.
